rows.desktop_responsibility: Build/dependency manifest for the Desktop/cloud-box local execution daemon.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: Remote Computer tooling can safely execute/read inside the cloud box with authenticated, bounded, streaming lifecycle semantics; this daemon itself is not an iOS-device process.
rows.ios_platform_delta: Do not embed a loopback shell/exec daemon in the iOS sandbox. The iOS product preserves the user-facing remote Computer capability by talking through the existing authenticated Coordinator/remote-computer service path; server/box execution ownership remains remote and is not duplicated into the app.
rows.production_evidence: mobile/ios/Fabushi/RemoteComputerSurface.swift (native remote Computer surface and lifecycle); source/ios-preload/coordinator-port-bridge.swift and Coordinator-owned remote service calls
rows.test_evidence: RemoteComputer focused tests plus current-head Rust Host/native MCP/runtime and protected/device Actions; service-side box daemon behavior remains owned by Desktop/backend deployment rather than the iOS binary.
